SELECT sc.School AS school_name, sc.MailStreet AS postal_street_address
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS sc
  ON sat.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sat.rtype = 'S'
  AND sat.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(sat.AvgScrMath AS INTEGER) DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT SUM("Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS enrolled_students
FROM frpm
WHERE "Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND "District Name" = 'Fremont'
  AND "School Name" = 'State Special School';

SELECT "School Name", "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND "Low Grade" = 'K'
  AND "High Grade" = '9';

SELECT TRIM(COALESCE(schools.AdmFName1, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(schools.AdmLName1, '')) AS Administrator
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT q.q1
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 354
  AND d.forename = 'Bruno'
  AND d.surname = 'Senna';

SELECT r.year, r.name, r.date, r.time
FROM drivers d
JOIN qualifying q ON q.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE d.dob = (
  SELECT MAX(d2.dob)
  FROM drivers d2
  JOIN qualifying q2 ON q2.driverId = d2.driverId
)
ORDER BY r.date ASC, r.round ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(CAST(results.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL))
FROM results
JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
WHERE races.year = 2009 AND races.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix';

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2008
  AND c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND q.position = 1;

SELECT major.major_name
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.phone = '809-555-3360';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM attendance
JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id
JOIN member ON attendance.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE event.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
AND LOWER(member.t_shirt_size) = 'medium';

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS student
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN expense AS x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = x.link_to_member
WHERE e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff';
